This Lighting build also keeps the look you designed in L-Connect: set it up
once in L-Connect, switch L-Connect off, and the plugin reads L-Connect's own
saved settings and re-applies the look on every boot, for every supported
device. With no saved look it behaves exactly like the Standard build. Do not
run it alongside another lighting tool (OpenRGB, SignalRGB, L-Connect or your
motherboard's RGB software); both would fight over the LEDs. Install only one
build at a time.
